cohort: The study included low risk postdate pregnant women scheduled for induction of labour at Korle- Bu Teaching Hospital.
finding: The 25ug misoprostol induction protocol proved effective and safe for the Ghanaian population with low risk postdate pregnancy, with a high rate of vaginal deliveries and no serious maternal complications.
mod_finding: Among the participants, 82.1% had a vaginal delivery and 17.9% had a caesarean section, with parity identified as the only significant predictor of vaginal delivery.
